intro: This unit looks at places a town pays for: public parks, school gyms, and Friday night lights. Lincoln Park in Chicago is one public park. A school board approves gym money. Electric lights let games go after dusk.

Then the unit looks at rules you can say. A painted line is a short rule. IFAB writes the Laws of the Game. The Football Association met in London on 26 October 1863. The IHSA handbook lets Illinois schools meet. This course still does not teach plays.
bigQuestion: Who builds the rooms for play, and who writes the short rules that strangers share?
